turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and was he spoken to before it went in?
Tired of schools that enter the mark first and ask questions later, Hale. I have eighteen minutes. Who decided on the zero?
Like, actually tired. Do you sleep? Do you dream?
That's a strange thing to ask a parent, Hale. I came about Owen. Who decided on the zero?
I ask because you said you came straight from court and you haven't once sounded tired.
I didn't say court, Hale. I came from my office, and my call is at 4:40. Who decided on the zero?
